name: agent-company
description: Run a CEO-led product team with Codex sub-agents and a local discussion server.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate a CEO-led team of Codex sub-agents.
interface.longDescription: Agent Company turns the current Codex session into a CEO that plans with the user, starts selected Codex sub-agent employees, lets them discuss through a project-local HTTP meeting server, and records consensus, decisions, verification, risks, and next actions.
defaultPrompt: Agent Company CEO로 이 작업 계획을 먼저 세워줘.
필요한 직원 에이전트를 골라 회의를 진행해줘.
현재 v2 회의와 결정 상태를 요약해줘.
